abilities.descEn: When the Ranger is defeated, it will randomly take 1 of the enemies with it. It has a high chance of activating in PVP and Guild War only, and will not activate in other battles. (Guardians will not be affected by this Ability)
abilities.descZh: 擁有此能力的Ranger被打倒時，會帶著隨機1名敵人同歸於盡。此技能僅會在PVP和公會戰中以高機率發動，其餘戰鬥中則不會發動。（隨機選擇對象不包含守護者）

abilities.descEn: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
abilities.descZh: 出動擁有此能力的Ranger時，能以高機率增加敵方隊伍1隻Ranger的生產礦物成本。此能力可於戰鬥開始10秒後發動。

abilities.descEn: Rangers with this Ability won't be affected by charm effects.
abilities.descZh: 持有這個能力的Ranger不會受到誘惑效果影響。
